description: Header file defining the internal class UnscaledCycleClock for accessing cycle counter values and frequency, used internally within the Abseil library.

classes.name: UnscaledCycleClock
classes.description: Internal class providing static methods to access cycle counter value and frequency.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns the current cycle counter value, implemented using the 'rdtsc' instruction on x86_64.

methods.name: Frequency
methods.description: Returns the estimated frequency of the cycle counter in cycles per second.
